key_insight: onPanda makes alignment annotation faster and more practical by letting annotators correct model outputs at the token level instead of rewriting whole responses. It turns human feedback into a stepwise, interactive correction loop that can be used for both LLMs and agent trajectories.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the high cost and inefficiency of collecting on-policy alignment data, where annotators often need to edit long model responses or agent behaviors from scratch. This makes it difficult to scale high-quality supervision for alignment and trajectory correction.
method: Annotators inspect a generated response and identify the first token that is inappropriate or incorrect.
They correct that token either by selecting from model-proposed candidate tokens or by free-form typing.
The system truncates the rest of the response after the corrected position and resumes generation from the new prefix, enabling iterative correction.
This workflow supports efficient annotation for both language model outputs and agent trajectories.
impact: For practitioners, onPanda can reduce annotation time and make alignment data collection more scalable and precise. This can improve the quality of training data for aligned LLMs and agents without requiring fully manual rewrites.

paper_title: onPanda: Efficient Annotation of On-Policy Alignment Data for LLMs and Agents via Token-Level Correction
paper_authors: Lei Yang, Mengyin Liu, Jia Wang, Hangyu Guo, Liang Zhao
